extracted.intended_audience: correspondents and contributors to the periodical 'Notes & Queries' (antiquaries, literary/historical correspondents, booksellers and subscribers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and practical requirements for readers who wish to contribute queries, replies, book notices, or buy/sell books via the periodical 'Notes & Queries'. Covers submission expectations, contact/procurement procedure, and publication/distribution timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brevity in communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Brevity in their communications is a merit which we shall never overlook; by compressing their articles within as small a compass as possible, they will enable us not only to give such communications more ready insertion, but also to increase the interest of every number of N. & Q. by treating in it of a greater variety of topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors should compress their articles to the smallest reasonable length to improve chances of insertion and to allow the journal to include a wider variety of topics in each issue. Excessive length reduces likelihood of publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide name and address for follow-up
rubrics_metrics.description: If P. H. (q. 364. p. 502. of No. 113.) will give his name and address, the Editor thinks that he can obtain for him some information on the subject of his inquiry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correspondents must supply names and addresses when making inquiries if they want the editor or other correspondents to be able to follow up or to obtain information on their behalf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clean-copy payment policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Full price will be given for clean copies of No. 19 upon application to our Publisher.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The periodical will pay full (stated) price for clean copies of specified issues when applicants apply to the publisher — sellers should present clean copies and apply directly to the publisher as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for 'Books and Odd Volumes' purchase offers
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters, stating particulars and lowest price, carriage free, to be sent to MR. BELL, Publisher of 'NOTES AND QUERIES', 186. Fleet Street.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sellers responding to 'Wanted to purchase' notices must send letters that state particulars of the volume(s) and the lowest price, and must offer carriage free; send correspondence to the named publisher address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication schedule and distribution timing
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTES AND QUERIES is published at noon on Friday, so that the Country Booksellers may receive Copies in that night's parcels, and deliver them to their Subscribers on the Saturday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors and booksellers should expect weekly publication at a specific time (noon Friday) to coordinate distribution — this timing explains how physical copies are routed to country booksellers for Saturday delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus and specimen material availability on application
rubrics_metrics.description: A Prospectus, with full particulars of the Maps and Atlases, and Descriptive Catalogues of Mr. Charles Knight's Publications, with Specimen Pages of New Works, forwarded, post free, on application to the Publisher.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishers will forward prospectuses, full particulars, descriptive catalogues, and specimen pages free by post upon request; potential purchasers or subscribers should apply to the publisher to receive these materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serial-publication format and pricing (examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Serialized works are issued in specified formats/prices — examples: The Companion Shakespeare: in numbers twice a month, each containing a single Play, sewed in a handsome wrapper, price 6d.; monthly parts price 1s.; whole forming four portable volumes. The Best Story-Tellers: in weekly numbers, price 2d. each, and in monthly parts, price 1s.; to be completed in 16 monthly parts. Half-Hours with the Best Authors: weekly numbers price 2d., monthly parts 1s., to be completed in 16 monthly parts. Other series list part-counts, formats, and prices similarly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors/publishers planning serialized publication should follow the announced packaging (number/part frequency), per-issue pricing, and final collected-volume structure. Advertised examples give specific expectations for content-per-number (e.g., a single play per number for the Companion Shakespeare) and completion schedules (total parts).
